reels.caption:
✨The best unique treehouses and elevated cabins around the world

📍 Treehotel — Harads, Sweden
Designer treehouses set in a northern forest — minimalist style, silence, and total immersion in nature.

📍 Arctic TreeHouse Hotel — Rovaniemi, Finland
Cabins on stilts with panoramic windows overlooking Lapland's forests and winter skies.

📍 Hapuku Lodge & Tree Houses — Kaikoura, New Zealand
Elevated treehouses surrounded by nature, with views stretching from mountains to the ocean.

📍 Tsala Treetop Lodge — Plettenberg Bay, South Africa
Luxury suites suspended above a forested gorge, offering complete privacy.

📍 Keemala — Phuket, Thailand
Iconic "bird's nest" villas hidden in the jungle, creating a fairytale sense of seclusion.

📍 Lion Sands Chalkley Treehouse — Kruger National Park, South Africa
An open-air treehouse platform for a once-in-a-lifetime night under the stars in the wild.

📍 Free Spirit Spheres — Vancouver Island, Canada
Suspended spherical cabins in a forest — a truly unusual and meditative stay.

📍 Treehouse Point — Washington State, USA
Cozy treehouses by the river, perfect for a quiet nature escape.

📍 Chewton Glen Treehouses — New Forest, England
Premium treehouse suites in an English woodland with full five-star hotel comfort.

📍 Azulik — Tulum, Mexico
Artistic treehouse-style villas blending nature, design, and a retreat-like atmosphere.
